assumptions: Expected-only mode: assertion ids = golden labels, txIds = tx:<command index>, positions = oracle's dense positions; $id/$tx/$pos symbols are mapped through a first-pass cutCatalog.
Golden reads without validAt use V = 1e15 (reader clock 'now', after every fixture instant).
The implicit ConfigStore release C0 of EP-REPO vectors is omitted (positions are symbolic in those vectors).

tiny-v4: config releases C1/C4 are internal commands (positions 1 and 4); every domain command enforces Required(:capacity/label) for CapacityEntity (the vector gives only 'all persisted rules of that release'); the repository schema is derived from the fixture's value families.

Golden 'native history relation' = oracle history.asOfSnapshot (known-at-cut); 'native facts relation' = oracle match.snapshot (live-at-valid); repository timeline = oracle assertionSnapshot known-at-valid.
Repository count(...) = oracle find total; find items = find pages[*].entities rendered as golden documents.
Journal facts (:_tx/change, :_tx/changed-entity) have no oracle query; Q11-Q13 of C6-01 are compared against the oracle's transaction record (changes, changedEntities) and labelled AGREE-DERIVED.
Number values are compared by IEEE binary64 bit pattern; int64 by decimal text; strings by codepoints.
